title: Morning Star Cottage & Carriage House
meta_description: Welcome to Morning Star, a luxury WaterColor retreat in the peaceful Forest District. Enjoy a private plunge pool courtyard, separate carriage house, plus a golf cart and bikes included for exploring 30A and nearby Seaside.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhy Guests Love Morning Star- Private Plunge Pool in Gated Courtyard- Golf Cart Included for Exploring WaterColor, Seaside, and 30A- Separate Carriage House Offering Extra Space and Privacy- Bikes Included for Riding the Scenic 30A Bike Trail- Quiet Location in WaterColor’s Beautiful Forest District- Spacious Layout Ideal for Families and Group Vacations- Easy Access to Camp WaterColor, Pools, Parks, and TrailsWelcome to Morning Star, a luxury WaterColor retreat designed for unforgettable 30A vacations. Tucked along a quiet, tree-lined street in the sought-after Forest District, this beautifully designed home features a private plunge pool courtyard, a separate carriage house for added privacy, and a golf cart for exploring WaterColor and 30A with ease.Spend your mornings biking to the beach, afternoons relaxing poolside, and evenings dining in nearby Seaside, Grayton Beach, and along scenic Highway 30A. With spacious living areas and thoughtful amenities throughout, Morning Star is the perfect home base for family vacations, couples trips, and group getaways.HOME LAYOUT (Sleeps 12)Main House1st Floor- Open Concept Living- Dining: Seating for 10, Including Island- Living Room: Seating for 7+- King Guest Suite: En Suite Bathroom w/ Walk-In Shower2nd Floor- Primary King Suite: Private Balcony, En Suite Bathroom w/ Soaking Tub & Walk-In Shower- King Guest Suite: En Suite Bathroom w/ Dual Vanities & Walk-In Shower- Bunk Room: Twin over Twin Bunk Beds & Queen Pull-Out Sofa- Full Bathroom: Shower/Tub Combo- Washer/DryerCarriage House2nd Floor- Private Queen Suite: Stand-Alone Shower- Queen Pull-Out Sofa- Kitchenette- Living AreaOutdoor Living- Private Plunge Pool- Gas Grill- Relaxing Outdoor Seating Areas- Peaceful Courtyard Surrounded by Trees- Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Coastal Living- Complimentary 6 Seater Golf Cart & BikesWaterColor AmenitiesGuests also enjoy access to the incredible amenities that make WaterColor one of the most sought-after communities along 30A.These include:• Resort-style community pools• Scenic walking and biking trails• Parks and green spaces• Beach access• Access to nearby restaurants, cafes, and shopsLocationMorning Star is ideally located within WaterColor’s Forest District, offering a peaceful setting while still being close to everything that makes 30A special.Nearby destinations include:• Seaside – iconic restaurants, shops, and events• Grayton Beach State Park – one of the most beautiful beaches in the country• WaterColor Beach Club• Scenic Highway 30A bike trail• Local restaurants, coffee shops, and boutiquesWhether you're planning a relaxing beach vacation, a family getaway, or a group trip to WaterColor and Scenic Highway 30A, Morning Star offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and location.Experience the beauty of Florida’s Emerald Coast and make unforgettable memories at Morning Star.
